Topic 6.1.3: Dua before and after waking up.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dua before and after waking up.. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read the dua before sleeping and (6 Lessons) the Sunnah.
2. Memorise the dua said before sleeping and after waking up.
3. Appreciate the recitation of the Learners repeatedly recite the Duas to dua before sleeping for Allah’s protection and dua after waking Learners complete the dua by picking up to thank Him.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Read the dua before sleeping and (6 Lessons) the Sunnah.

2. Memorise the dua said before sleeping and after waking up.

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dua before and after waking up..
2. Explain Dua before and after waking up. to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dua before and after waking up..
4. Show that you can: Read the dua before sleeping and (6 Lessons) the Sunnah.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dua before and after waking up.. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Dua before and after waking up. important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Read the dua before sleeping and (6 Lessons) the Sunnah.
2. Memorise the dua said before sleeping and after waking up.
